title: Presentations of bounded coherent support groups and generic-length cycles
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme]. Use the coherent objects [def-sfb-coherent-grothendieck-support], i.e. coherent module sheaves on $X$. For $r\in\mathbf Z$, define $C_r(X)$ to consist of these objects whose nonzero-stalk support [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk] has topological Krull dimension [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension] at most $r$ when $r\geq0$, and of zero objects when $r<0$. Define $K_0(C_r(X))$ as the free abelian group on these objects modulo isomorphism relations and $[B]-[A]-[C]$ for every ambient short exact sequence [def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence] with all three terms in $C_r(X)$, and denote its generator by $[M]$. For $k\in\mathbf N$, index integral closed subschemes of dimension $k$ by their irreducible [def-weil-irreducible-components] closed supports, endowed with their unique reduced induced scheme structure [lem-weil-pbc-reduced-induced-closed-subscheme]. Let $Z_k(X)$ be the finitely supported integer functions on this index set, the free abelian group on those indices. Let $\eta_V$ be the generic point of the irreducible closed support and define $\ell_V(M)=\operatorname{length}_{\mathcal O_{X,\eta_V}}M_{\eta_V}$ [def-weil-pbc-module-length]. A homomorphism $\iota:K_0(C_{k-1}(X))\to K_0(C_k(X))$ is induced by inclusion when it sends every object generator to the same module's class in the larger category (equivalently, to the class of every isomorphic representative). A homomorphism $c:K_0(C_k(X))\to Z_k(X)$ satisfies the generic-length formula when its coefficient at $V$ on $[M]$ is the integer $\ell_V(M).\mathrm{toNat}$; the associated theorem separately asserts finite length so that this conversion is the actual length.
